title: GTA 6 Gameplay Surprises Fans in the Latest Episode of South Park
description: Rockstar Games' marketing for GTA 6 takes a wild turn as brand new gameplay footage featuring Jason and anti-social behavior crops up in South Park.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## An Unexpected Stage for GTA 6 Marketing

We already know that Grand Theft Auto 6 has a marketing deal in place with Sony and the PlayStation 5, and that Rockstar Games has been engaging with real-world locations to spread the word about its upcoming sandbox title ahead of its November 19 launch. However, it appears the reach of Rockstar's marketing arm truly knows no bounds, as brand-new gameplay footage cropped up in a thoroughly unexpected place: the latest episode of South Park.

## Dog Poo, Anti-Social Behaviour, and Jason

While traditional marketing channels usually involve trailers, developer deep-dives, or platform-exclusive partnerships, Rockstar's latest promotional push surprised everyone. During last night's broadcast of South Park, eagle-eyed viewers were treated to unexpected glimpses of gameplay footage from the highly anticipated title.

The unexpected footage showcased quintessential elements that fans have come to expect from the franchise, including dog poo, various forms of anti-social behaviour, and a look at Jason, one of the game's protagonists. Integrating gameplay into a satirical animated show like South Park is an unconventional and brilliant move, leaning heavily into the chaotic spirit that the series represents.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar's decision to sneak GTA 6 footage into South Park is a masterclass in modern, organic marketing. By aligning the game with edgy, pop-culture satire—highlighting everything from anti-social behavior to Jason—they are keeping the hype train rolling in a way that feels fresh and authentically tied to the franchise's rebellious roots.
